subject: Revolution R Open 8.0.3 is now available for download

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Revolution R Open 8.0.3 is now available for download
parts:
We're pleased to announce that Revolution R Open 8.0.3 is now available for download for Windows, Mac, Ubuntu, RedHat/CentOS and OpenSUSE. You can download it from:

http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/

This version updates the R engine to 3.1.3, adds support for Ubuntu 15.04, and updates the "checkpoint" package. You can find more details about the release in the Revolutions blog post:
http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/2015/05/revolution-r-open-803-now-available.html

Note that on Windows/Linux, to enable multi-threading you need to download and install the separate MKL from the download page. If you installed RRO 8.0.2 for Windows, be sure to follow the installation instructions carefully (you will need to uninstall MKL first).

Enjoy!

# David Smith

messages.author: 2aed7cbfca222ffd
messages.subject: Re: Revolution R Open 8.0.3 is now available for download
parts:
Hi Jonathan,

1.   No - we did not have a MKL installer for RRO for 8.0.1 - you will need to upgrade to version 8.,0.3.
2).  Yes. you will need to uninstall and reinstall the MKL component for each new release of RRO. You can find complete install and uninstall instructions for the MKL installer here:
      http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/

3).  You should uninstall your previous version of RRO(8.0.1) and then install the new version of Revolution R Open using the instructions for the version of Linux you are running.
      See:   http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/


Stephen Weller
